The animator, the tween engine (tweens, timelines, manager) and the easing curves and paths that move a value over time.
Learn: [Animation](/use/learn/style-and-motion/animation/).

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`TweenEquation`](/reference/animation/tweenequation/) | class | Easing curve that turns the elapsed part of a step into its progress. |
| [`BackTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/backtweenequation/) | class | Easing curves that move back a little before they start or go past the end before they settle. |
| [`BounceTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/bouncetweenequation/) | class | Easing curves that bounce, like a ball that falls and rebounds. |
| [`CircTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/circtweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along quarter circles. |
| [`CubicTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/cubictweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along a power of 3. |
| [`ElasticTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/elastictweenequation/) | class | Easing curves that oscillate like a spring at the start or at the end. |
| [`ExpoTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/expotweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along an exponential. |
| [`LinearTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/lineartweenequation/) | class | Easing curve of constant speed. |
| [`QuadTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/quadtweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along a power of 2. |
| [`QuartTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/quarttweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along a power of 4. |
| [`QuintTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/quinttweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along a power of 5. |
| [`SineTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/sinetweenequation/) | class | Easing curves along a sine. |

## Related types

The interfaces, enums and helper classes of this family that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`BaseTween`](/reference/animation/basetween/) | class | Shared state and timing of a tween and a timeline: delay, repetitions, pause, events and the advance in time. |
| [`CatmullRomTweenPath`](/reference/animation/catmullromtweenpath/) | class | Smooth path through every waypoint of a tween, along a Catmull-Rom spline. |
| [`ITweenPath`](/reference/animation/itweenpath/) | interface | Curve that joins the start, the waypoints and the target of a tween. |
| [`LinearTweenPath`](/reference/animation/lineartweenpath/) | class | Path made of straight segments between the waypoints of a tween. |
| [`Timeline`](/reference/animation/timeline/) | class | Plays tweens and other timelines one after the other or all together, as one tween. |
| [`Tween`](/reference/animation/tween/) | class | Moves one `float` value, read and written through a getter and a setter, to a target over a duration. |
| [`TweenAnimator`](/reference/animation/tweenanimator/) | class | Read-only `float` signal that a timeline of tweens moves over time, the usual way to animate a node. |
| [`TweenEquations`](/reference/animation/tweenequations/) | class | Every easing curve of JOID as a constant, and the lookup of a curve by its name. |
| [`TweenEvent`](/reference/animation/tweenevent/) | class | Event fired by a tween or a timeline at the start and at the end of its plays. |
| [`TweenManager`](/reference/animation/tweenmanager/) | class | Holds tweens and timelines and advances them together when you update it. |
| [`TweenPaths`](/reference/animation/tweenpaths/) | class | The paths of JOID that join the waypoints of a tween. |
